verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is a REST/OpenAI-compatible API (base_url + api_key model, keyless model enumeration) that is inherently scriptable and stateless, making it straightforward to call from CI/automation pipelines without any UI dependency. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD examples (GitHub Actions, cron jobs), no official CLI, and no independent hands-on report of someone running it headlessly in a pipeline.
